description: This Java source file defines the class ModuleFilterConfig, which implements the FilterConfig interface to configure servlet filters within the OpenMRS web application. It provides methods for creating filter configurations based on ModuleFilterDefinition instances, and allows access to filter parameters and servlet context.

classes.name: ModuleFilterConfig
classes.description: Implementation of FilterConfig to encapsulate filter configurations for modules, with factory method for creation and accessors for filter properties.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ModuleFilterConfig with specified filter definition and servlet context.

methods.name: getFilterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter from the associated ModuleFilterDefinition.

methods.name: getInitParameter
methods.description: Retrieves the initialization parameter value for a given parameter name from the filter definition.

methods.name: getInitParameterNames
methods.description: Returns an enumeration of all initialization parameter names defined in the filter definition.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Getter for the filter definition object.

methods.name: setFilterDefinition
methods.description: Setter for the filter definition object.

methods.name: getServletContext
methods.description: Returns the servlet context associated with this filter configuration.
